missions.title: Room for the Next Check
missions.knowledgeQuestion: What can a handover keep open for the next person?

objectives.title: Check both pieces in a practice bundle and choose where to place the handover.

hints.text: Lia left a practice bundle on the middle table.
Use the two inspection actions to see what each piece carries.
The clips and strips work here. A matching tool from your Bag can open one piece too.
After checking both pieces, pin the public notice at the east wall or leave the handover at the west bench. A new bundle will be ready.

journal.text: Lia’s room gives the next keeper one place to look. We kept the conditions and source lines with the bundle and left space for a later check.
